date.as_written: abhrarāmagajesaṃkhye nepālābde gate ravau navamyāṃ varuṇe sakṣe

notes: Dāmodara is the author of the text (dāmodarakṛtau). The scribe is not named, though the verb vyalīlikhat indicates the manuscript was written on Sunday, the 9th tithi (nakṣatra Vāruṇa/Śatabhiṣā?) in NS 830 (abhra = 0, rāma = 3, gaja = 8).
